name: card_content_controls_v1
purpose: Prospective four-condition content-specific transfer check on new applicable Up3 maps. Fixed b0, not learning or theta4 recovery.
selection: First16 exact new board/position pairs where unchanged full5 library original top1+guard gives skill_4 score>=.8. Exclude all historical/withinpool identities, all prior1079 CPU-screened states, and reserved Test. No model outcomes or BFS difficulty selection; fixed candidate pool, insufficient16 means no inference.

conditions.N: Immutable empty library, ordinary observation only.
conditions.V: Original actual skill_4 bitmap, unchanged SKILL_INTRO; full real five-card library.
conditions.Blank: Same intro, same image slot/order/RGB dimensions, white pixels replacing entire reference card only. Original environment observation unchanged.
conditions.Text: Same intro plus fixed transcription of original strategy, source-board symbols, original player positions and action sequence; no reference bitmap and no target-state facts. Text differs in token count and representation; not a token-length control.

primary_metrics: paired full success V-N and V-Blank
secondary_metrics: Text-N/Text-V paired success and quality, diagnostic only
unsupported Stop and natural executed actions
shadow reward support and stall patterns, never applied
PPO_investment_gate: All64 complete; correct condition input/no contamination/no mutation; for BOTH V-N and V-Blank, success AND quality net>=4/16 (25pp), with <=1 regression each. Screening threshold only, not statistical learning evidence. If fail do not enlarge PPO. If pass independently assess seed/critic/numerical/cross-context feasibility under remaining original clock before any new protocol; no automatic full P2/P3.
stop: Exactly16 new maps x4 max64 full episodes/320 calls. No added samples, output-conditioned replacement, prompt revisions, cross-protocol pooling, best-condition selection or training. Failure/repair preserves calls, episodes, first clock. Lambda training stays off regardless of shadow positivity.
